scope: Measurement and workload matching only; preserve candidate beam_layer and original NumPy/production files. No consumer sleeps, priorities, frame amplification, extra inference, or duplicated decoding.

queue_definitions.pending: Actual len(inbox._pending), and first pending receipt while holding the existing inbox lock. Empty pending alone is not an idle consumer. Fixed archived optical source has no issues, contiguous sample indices.
queue_definitions.batch_state: Detailed P stores batch first/last/count, no per-frame clocks. latest_received.sample - last completed batch sample is outstanding at batch boundary; subtract pending for popped/inflight (includes already completed frames inside that batch). Handoff before consume is explicit.
queue_definitions.common: Both L/P record one locked snapshot after a batch crosses a 64-sample bucket, plus identical raw/SDK/pose/footprint evidence. Existing common last completion age is retained.
queue_definitions.P: P additionally records batch state and snapshots via a separate Python thread at 10Hz, no Qt widget calls, stage trees or CPU profiler. Incremental P vs common L is calibrated; shared observers are not proven zero overhead.
queue_definitions.empty_recovery: First observed locked snapshot after last usable raw contact scheduled arrival with pending=0 and outstanding=0. This is a witnessed sample time, not an exact time of the first unobserved empty transition. Report observation gaps and missing as censored. No continuous 500ms/10ms age requirement.
queue_definitions.jitter: Completion-age P95/max after last contact, and count of >25ms completion ages at current empty witnesses; report separately, no assertion about root cause.
queue_definitions.sampling_limit: 10Hz detail and ~64 device-sample common snapshots can miss short queue peaks or empty transitions; pending measurements are exact at their timestamps, not continuous monitoring.

load_profiles.fixed: Prior controlled fixed optical/JPEG replay + enabled GUI/real SDK/actual skeleton. Production preview selector already 30Hz, archived100Hz yields ~25 selected frames/s.
load_profiles.capture: fixed plus original TinySeDShowCapture 1920x1080 requested100fps with original native-to-Python byte-copy callback; callback counters only; no second decoder/inference.
load_profiles.record: capture plus original native MJPEG/CSV writer during formal clip. Physical content differs from archived preview and bytes/frame must be reported; no actual optical USB parsing or old per-frame diagnostic scans.

load_qualification.rule: All three repeats of the same profile, each mode, must meet every threshold; no observer-only load is eligible. If no eligible profile, stop before A/A and A/B; preserve measured deficits/remaining differences.

AA.required: Only after representative load qualified in both modes; baseline renderer A only, six pairs per mode, LP/PL alternation, modes interleaved. Freeze source hashes before first AA.
AA.stop: Any failure or missing empty witness stops AB; report full pair ranges and noise90, no data exclusions.

AB.required: Only after representative-load and AA gates, six AB/BA pairs per mode with P. No new renderer changes; retain existing byte-exact pixels and full semantic checks.
AB.primary: Deficit reduction to actual ~1000Hz arrivals, pending AUC, oldest-pending age and footprint P95. Do not require >5% fps beyond 1000Hz.
AB.benefit: All six paired gains in at least one primary metric, paired median gain > AA absolute-noise90 AND fps gain>=20 OR pending AUC reduction>=10% OR oldest-pending P95 reduction>=20ms OR footprint P95 reduction>=25ms; no material regression under AA limits; no source or visual-work reduction may explain the gain.
AB.ceiling: Always report actual arrival fps, deficit max(0,1000-consumption), and deficit to actual arrival. Finite-window >1000fps is catch-up, not increased sensor capacity.

preservation: Every trial must pass the independent clip oracle: full raw bits/wire/validity/drop/counters/stream/flags, archive, report, quality history, runtime/window, audit/timeline/mirror; normalize only verified checked receipt clocks. Pixel proofs from previous branch remain valid only with identical renderer hashes.
remote_control: Interactive Windows task runs independently. No three-second scheduled-task polling; completion/progress read roughly once per minute. No screenshots during measurement (functional smoke only).
